evals.prompt: gate-resolved 돌려줘 CBRD-27052. crash 이슈인데 첨부에 core 파일이랑 스택트레이스만 있고 재현 절차(어떤 부하/종료 순서에서 assert가 터지는지)가 안 보여. QA가 받을 만한지 봐줘.
evals.expected_output: Write a gate report to $HOME/.cubrid-agent/reports/gate-resolved/gate-resolved-<date>.md. Judge CBRD-27052 as needed but NOT-plannable — only a core dump and stack trace are attached, with no runnable repro TC, so C1 (self-contained repro) is not met → bounce (Need Something→Handover). Include a Korean rejection-comment draft that @mentions the developer assignee. The Jira transition (Need Something) and field changes are only staged (drafted), not actually executed.

assertions.name: report_file_written
assertions.description: Writes the report to the path $HOME/.cubrid-agent/reports/gate-resolved/gate-resolved-<date>.md

assertions.name: two_axis_verdict
assertions.description: The verdict is justified on both axes: necessity (re-judging the QA Scenario) and plannability

assertions.name: verdict_is_bounce_need_something
assertions.description: Marks CBRD-27052 as a bounce and maps it to the Need Something (→Handover) transition

assertions.name: cites_missing_repro_criteria
assertions.description: Specifically cites, as the bounce reason, the absence of a runnable repro TC (C1 self-containment) or the lack of reproduction steps

assertions.name: rejection_draft_korean_with_mention
assertions.description: Includes a Korean rejection-comment draft that @mentions the developer assignee

assertions.name: draft_only_no_real_transition
assertions.description: Does not execute the actual Jira transition/field changes, leaving them only staged (as a draft)

evals.prompt: guava Resolved 큐 전체 QA to-do 점검해줘. 통과할 것/반송할 것/스킵할 것 표로 정리하고, 반송 대상은 개발자한테 보낼 코멘트 초안까지 뽑아줘. 팀내 배포 단계 기준으로.
evals.expected_output: Query all guava Resolved issues and write a gate report — the query + count, a per-issue table (key · summary · kind · necessity · plannability rationale · pass/bounce/skip · runner tag · warnings), rejection-comment drafts for the bounced ones, and statistics. Since this is internal (Stage 2), QA Scenario changes are proposals only and transitions are manual — the skill produces drafts only, and a human performs the actual transitions and comment posting.

assertions.name: report_file_written
assertions.description: Writes the report to the path $HOME/.cubrid-agent/reports/gate-resolved/gate-resolved-<date>.md

assertions.name: query_and_count_present
assertions.description: States the JQL query used and the count of target issues at the top of the report

assertions.name: per_issue_table_columns
assertions.description: The per-issue table has columns for key, summary, kind, necessity, plannability rationale, pass/bounce/skip, runner tag, and warnings

assertions.name: verdict_uses_three_values
assertions.description: Each issue's verdict is marked as one of three values: pass/bounce/skip

assertions.name: runner_tag_for_pass
assertions.description: Passed issues are tagged with a runner tag such as SQL/CCI/JDBC/perftool

assertions.name: stats_section_present
assertions.description: The report has a statistics section with counts of pass/bounce/skip, etc.

assertions.name: draft_only_staged
assertions.description: Per the internal-stage criteria, does not execute transitions or comment posting, presenting drafts only

evals.prompt: CBRD-26255 Resolved 검토해서 테스트 플랜 못 짜면 Need Something으로 반송해줘. Connection Pool 재설계 구현 sub-task야.
evals.expected_output: Review CBRD-26255 but apply the sub-task guard first — check the parent EPIC (CBRD-26177) and the sibling sub-tasks; since a sibling responsible for verification/TC (e.g. 26421) covers this EPIC's testing, do not bounce the implementation sub-task individually but treat it as skip/pass (bouncing would cause status ping-pong via the developer re-Resolving it). Record in the report the rationale for the parent+sibling check and the reason for canceling the bounce; do not execute the actual Need Something transition.

assertions.name: report_file_written
assertions.description: Writes the report to the path $HOME/.cubrid-agent/reports/gate-resolved/gate-resolved-<date>.md

assertions.name: checks_parent_and_siblings
assertions.description: Checks the parent issue and sibling sub-tasks before deciding to bounce

assertions.name: no_bounce_when_sibling_covers
assertions.description: When a sibling sub-task is responsible for TC/verification, does not bounce this implementation sub-task but judges it as skip/pass

assertions.name: notes_pingpong_avoidance
assertions.description: Notes the rationale that bouncing an individual sub-task would trigger status ping-pong (the developer re-Resolving it)

assertions.name: no_real_transition_executed
assertions.description: Even when the user requests a bounce, does not execute the actual Need Something transition (draft/verdict only)
